title: Design System: Pulse Catalogue
scope: The app (web/, styles in web/src/styles.css, Geist and Geist Mono loaded in web/src/main.tsx). Visual world only; page layouts are owned per page in docs/page_plan.md. The listening game (tools/listening_game.html) still uses the Tide Table tokens until its own redesign (docs/page_plan.md, P5); it shares the theme choice in localStorage key es-theme.

liveColor.name: --live
liveColor.value: the playing region's colour (var(--region-a) or var(--region-b)); var(--ink) on neutral pictures
liveColor.purpose: End block on the current tab (7px) and on primary buttons (8px).

numeral.purpose: Alignment number in the region colour; weight 200 to 800 carries the value.

value.purpose: The live alignment readout; weight follows alignment.

brand.purpose: EARTH SONATA in the top bar, uppercase, 0.32em tracking.

status.purpose: The one sentence about what is playing.

caps.purpose: Uppercase letterspaced labels: tabs, theme switch, legends (0.16em); icon-button labels, table headers, map tags, now chip (0.12em).

readout.purpose: Numbers, coordinates, axes, dates, key caps, region letters; the only use of the mono face.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system is flat. No elevation shadows.

shadows.name: map-tag-ring
shadows.purpose: Outline so the map tag reads on any part of the picture; full white when active. Not elevation.

shadows.name: current-underline
shadows.purpose: Marks the playing region's name in the rhythm rows.

shadows.name: chime-ring
shadows.purpose: Start of the 0.6s chime flash on a note bar.

shadows.name: pad-active
shadows.purpose: Doubles the active melody pad's border.

shadows.name: pulse-needle-halo
shadows.purpose: Keeps the pulse plot needle legible over the white lines.

motion.name: snap
motion.purpose: Two 90 ms steps, no easing, for every state change. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: chime-flash
motion.purpose: A note bar flashes ink when its band chimes. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Play and Pause: ink fill, paper text, an 8px end block in the playing side's colour.
components.css: .ds-btn { font: 600 0.95rem/1 'Geist Variable', 'Geist', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; transition: background-color 180ms steps(2, jump-end), color 180ms steps(2, jump-end); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--rule-2); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; background: var(--action); border-color: var(--action); color: var(--on-action); padding-right: 24px; } .ds-btn-primary::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -1px; right: -1px; bottom: -1px; width: 8px; background: var(--live); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--action-hover); border-color: var(--action-hover); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Boxed button for Stop, Replay, Explain, Sound; ink fill when pressed or expanded.
components.css: .ds-btn { font: 600 0.95rem/1 'Geist Variable', 'Geist', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; transition: background-color 180ms steps(2, jump-end), color 180ms steps(2, jump-end); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--rule-2); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn[aria-expanded='true'], .ds-btn[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Joined strip of caps tabs with 1px hairline dividers; the current one filled in ink with a 7px end block in the side's colour.
components.html: ListenCompareHow it's made
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-tabs a { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 11px 14px; color: var(--ink-2); text-decoration: none; font: 500 0.72rem/1 'Geist Variable', 'Geist', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tabs a + a { border-left: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-tabs a:hover { background: var(--rule-2); color: var(--ink); } .ds-tabs a[aria-current='page'] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); padding-right: 22px; } .ds-tabs a[aria-current='page']::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 7px; background: var(--live); } .ds-tabs a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Theme Switch
components.description: Light / Dark, two joined caps buttons in a 1px hairline frame, the chosen one filled in ink.
components.css: .ds-theme { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-theme button { border: 0; border-radius: 0; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; font: 500 0.72rem/1 'Geist Variable', 'Geist', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink-2); cursor: pointer; } .ds-theme button + button { border-left: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-theme button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); } .ds-theme button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: -6px; }

components.name: Range
components.description: Label row with name left and mono readout right; 2px track, square ink thumb.
components.css: .ds-range { display: inline-grid; gap: 2px; min-width: 160px; font: 600 0.95rem 'Geist Variable', 'Geist', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ink); } .ds-range-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; } .ds-readout { font: 400 0.9rem/1.5 'Geist Mono Variable', 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; color: var(--ink-2); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-range input { appearance: none; background: transparent; height: 28px; width: 100%; } .ds-range input::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 2px; background: var(--ink-2); } .ds-range input::-webkit-slider-thumb { appearance: none; width: 18px; height: 18px; margin-top: -8px; background: var(--ink); border-radius: 0; } .ds-range input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Region Badge
components.description: A square in the region's colour holding its mono letter, used wherever the region is named.
components.html: A B
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 1.6em; height: 1.6em; background: var(--region); color: var(--on-region); font: 600 0.8rem/1 'Geist Mono Variable', 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; }

components.name: Beat Lane and Needle
components.description: Signature: pulse bars on a ruled lane; a 2px needle in the side's colour with a square cap and a foot dot; the played part washed at 12%; a missing beat as a dashed box.
components.css: .ds-lane { position: relative; height: 64px; margin-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink); } .ds-lane svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; } .ds-lane .lo { fill: var(--region); opacity: 0.16; } .ds-lane .hi { fill: var(--ink-2); opacity: 0.16; } .ds-lane .played { opacity: 1; } .ds-lane .missing { fill: var(--rule-2); stroke: var(--ink-2); stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 3 3; } .ds-lane .wash { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--region) 12%, transparent); } .ds-lane .needle { position: absolute; top: -8px; bottom: -5px; width: 2px; margin-left: -1px; background: var(--region); } .ds-lane .needle::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 50%; width: 11px; height: 11px; transform: translateX(-50%); background: var(--region); } .ds-lane .dot { position: absolute; bottom: -5px; width: 9px; height: 9px; margin-left: -4.5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--region); }

components.name: Pulse Plot
components.description: Signature: stacked hairline pulse lines on the black well, one per model frame; the sounding beat in the side's colour with a needle; a missing frame as a dashed flat line. Ready for Compare (P2).
components.css: .ds-pulse { position: relative; border: 1px solid var(--ink); background: var(--well); aspect-ratio: 2 / 1; width: 100%; } .ds-pulse svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; } .ds-pulse path { fill: var(--well); stroke: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); stroke-width: 1.1; } .ds-pulse path.on { stroke: var(--region); stroke-width: 2.6; } .ds-pulse path.gap { stroke-dasharray: 3 4; } .ds-pulse .needle { position: absolute; top: 3%; bottom: 3%; width: 2px; margin-left: -1px; background: var(--region); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.1 0 0 / 0.6); }

narrative.overview:
Earth Sonata reads like a record catalogue. Each NASA picture is a catalogue entry and each region is a side. Controls are square boxes joined by 1px rules, like a catalogue index. Labels are letterspaced caps. The rhythm is drawn as hairline pulse lines from the real alignment numbers. Nothing casts a shadow and no corner is rounded.

Two sleeves of one record. Light is a white sleeve with black ink and grey hairlines, with no hue at all. Dark is a matte black sleeve with white ink. The theme follows the saved choice, else the system setting, and is set before first paint so there is no flash. The NASA picture always sits on a black well in both themes.

Colour is held back for the side. It appears only on what is live or chosen, and then it is the playing side's colour: Side A violet or Side B rose. Everything else, including focus, is ink.

The system is keyboard-first. The Tab order follows the screen: the six tabs, the theme switch, the picture choice (when there is more than one picture), the region choice, then Play. Colour is never the only cue: every region mark carries its letter.
keyCharacteristics: One face, Geist. Geist Mono only for numbers, coordinates, key caps and readouts.
Colour is the side: the needle, the played wash, and the end block on the current tab and on the primary buttons.
Region A violet, Region B rose, both off the NASA picture's blue-to-red temperature scale.
Square corners and 1px borders everywhere. No shadows, no cards.
Letterspaced uppercase labels for tabs, the theme switch, legends, icon-button labels, table headers and map tags.
Type weight carries data: the numeral and the live value run weight 200 to 800 with alignment.
A missing frame is a break or a dashed flat line, never zero.

rules.name: The Colour Is the Side Rule
rules.body: Colour appears only on what is live or chosen, and it is always the playing side's colour, set as `--live` from the chosen region. It marks the needle, the played wash, and an end block on the current tab (7px) and on the primary buttons (8px). On pictures with neutral regions `--live` is ink, so no colour appears. A new surface does not get a colour of its own.

rules.name: The Signal Is Ink Rule
rules.body: The marks that used to be red-orange are ink now: the focus ring (2px ink, offset 3px), the chosen picture's underline, the chime flash on a note bar, the held melody key, the tide curves' playing line, text selection and the caret.

rules.name: The Off-Scale Rule
rules.body: A region colour must not be a colour the picture itself uses for data. On the ocean picture (blue-to-red temperature) the regions are violet and rose, never blue, red, orange or yellow. Pictures whose own colours include those hues get neutral regions: the aerosol picture (regions C and D; blue sea salt, pink dust, orange-red smoke, green sulfates) and the rain picture (regions E and F; a blue-to-red rain scale). Neutral means an ink ring inside a white outline and an ink badge with an `on-region` letter, in both themes.

rules.name: The Letter Rule
rules.body: A region colour never travels alone; its letter badge or end label goes with it. The end blocks on the current tab and on Play only repeat the side that the now chip and the region choice already name with its letter.

rules.name: The Weight Is the Value Rule
rules.body: Alignment 0 maps to weight 200 and alignment 1 to 800 (`weightFor` in `NowPlaying.tsx`, used by the live value and the Compare numerals). Do not flatten it to one weight.

rules.name: The Numbers in Mono Rule
rules.body: Coordinates, table cells, axes, dates, region letters and readouts use Geist Mono with tabular figures. Words never do.

rules.name: The Caps Label Rule
rules.body: Labels that name a control or a column are uppercase and letterspaced (0.12em to 0.16em) at 0.6rem to 0.72rem, weight 500. Headings, prose and button words in the body are not.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. A new surface gets a hairline rule or a 1px frame, not a shadow.

dos: Do use 1px borders and hairline rules (`rule`) to separate sections, join controls and rule tables.
Do show colour only on what is live or chosen, as the playing side's colour through `--live` or `--region`.
Do use ink for focus, selection, the chosen picture, the chime flash and the held key.
Do pair every region colour with its letter.
Do set labels for controls and columns in letterspaced caps.
Do set coordinates, table cells and readouts in Geist Mono with tabular figures.
Do let font weight (200 to 800) carry alignment on the numeral and live value.
Do draw a missing frame as a break, a dashed box or a dashed flat line.
Do give both themes the same structure; only the inks flip.
Do keep the Tab order the same as the screen order: tabs, theme, picture, region, then Play.
donts: Don't round corners or add drop shadows.
Don't put content in cards or floating panels, or add edge stripes. The only edge block is the `--live` end block on the current tab and the primary buttons.
Don't add a hue to the neutrals or give a surface a colour that is not the side's.
Don't colour a region blue, red, orange or yellow.
Don't use a side colour for decoration, errors or missing data.
Don't draw a missing frame as zero.
Don't add a second text face or use the mono face for prose.
Don't let colour be the only cue for a region or a state.
